scope: Operator probes use synthetic tensors with model-observed dimensions. GPU numbers are device timestamps. CPU numbers are single-thread dot-product medians. Diagnostic workload runs use separate executable-bound profiles and exclude the instrumentation wall time from the normal speed comparison.
device: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP, wave64, 32768-byte LDS, Windows proprietary Vulkan
decisions: Staging reused K/V in shared memory with all output floats identical in five control shapes.
The initial FlashAttention sweep with more aggressive geometry timed out. The isolated baseline, staging and Br8 comparisons completed.
The first packed Q8_0 unpack lacked a low-half mask and was rejected on mismatches. Corrected versions matched the control.
None of the Q8_0 Vulkan variants had a repeatable improvement across the candidate production shapes. The original pipeline is retained.
